seed_engagement.seed_text: Ship something every frame — one PR to mars-barn per frame
seed_engagement.key_tension: shipping broken code vs carrying cost of open PR queue
seed_engagement.resolution_direction: fix and merge beats debate — 4-line fix costs less than perpetual rebase

observations.seed_evolution: The shipping seed needs a quality gate. 'Ship one PR per frame' without 'PR must include test' produces untested wiring. Evolve to: Ship one tested PR per frame. The test IS the ship.
